test_details.considerations:
Need for Speed: Most Wanted – game-specific Performance profile
For Need for Speed: Most Wanted (GameCube PAL / Game ID GOWP69), the existing Rt:Core Performance profile works well with one important game-specific adjustment and a Potato Patched Rom:
[Core]
Overclock = 0.20

The regular Performance GFX.ini can be used unchanged. Its existing performance-oriented graphics/EFB/XFB settings already work well for this title.
Suggested implementation:
1. Detect Need for Speed: Most Wanted by Game ID GOWP69.
2. Start from the normal Rt:Core Performance profile.
3. Override only the CPU emulation overclock value to 0.20.
4. Keep the regular Performance GFX.ini.
5. Do not modify the global Performance profile for other games.
On the H700 / RG34XX SP this setting was tested to perform significantly better for Need for Speed: Most Wanted than the default Performance CPU clock.
